blocks.tamil_translation: the food.’ Hearing this, the angels said, “Explain it clearly to him, so that he may understand!” One angel said, “But he is sleeping.” (What is the use of explaining it clearly?) Another said, “Only the eyes are sleeping; the heart is awake.’ Then he said, “The house is Jannah (Allah Ta'ala created it, placed all kinds of blessings in it, and arranged a feast there). The caller (who calls towards that Jannah) is Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ. Whoever obeyed the Prophet ﷺ has obeyed Allah. (So he will enter Jannah and receive the blessings there.) Whoever disobeyed Muhammad ﷺ has disobeyed Allah. (So he will lose the blessings of Jannah.) Muhammad ﷺ has made a distinction (among people, between those who obey and those who do not).”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The sleep of the Prophets (AS) being different from the sleep of other people is a special quality exclusive to them. Generally, when people sleep, they do not perceive anything that happens. But the Prophets (AS), even during sleep, fully know what is happening around them. At that time only the eyes sleep. The heart remains fully awake, engaged in the remembrance of Allah.
(Badhl-ul-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّمَا مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ مَا بَعَثَنِيَ اللهُ بِهِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ أَتَي قَوْماً فَقَالَ: يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ الْجَيْشَ بِعَيْنَيَّ، وَإِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْعُرْيَانُ فَالنَّجَاءَ، فَأَطَاعَهُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ فَأَدْلَجُوا فَانْطَلَقُوا عَلَي مَهَلِهِمْ فَنَجَوْا، وَكَذَّبَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا مَكَانَهُمْ، فَصَبَّحَهُمُ الْجَيْشُ فَأَهْلَكَهُمْ وَاجْتَاحَهُمْ، فَذلِكَ مَثَلُ مَنْ
